decision.application_limit: Graphs presence takes precedence over Networks even mixed/empty/wrong-type legacy shape. Invalid ResourceLocation or codec getOrThrow can abort; missing conduit registry entry skipped without opaque retention. IndexedEdgeList expands raw indices via list.get without local bounds validation; graph constructor validates nonempty/ownership/endpoints and forbids self loop through Guava, but does not verify connectivity, unique positions or graph-to-conduit consistency. Unclaimed same type+position nodes overwrite in map; node holder mismatch removes candidate before returning null, trusting BE fallback.
